note: `audience` drives both the 'For' line on the home service docket and the 'Which service fits you?' matrix on the services index — keep the three keys on every entry. `notFor` is the redirect line that prevents wrong-service enquiries. `ref` is the file number the docket lists print in the right-hand column.

list.title: Job Placement
list.shortDescription: We match you to roles worth taking, then help you close the offer.
list.description: Hands-on support from resume to signed offer — matching, coaching, and negotiation help for candidates who want a job placed, not just applications sent.
list.notFor: Not for employers hiring — start with Recruitment & Staffing.

list.title: Recruitment & Staffing
list.shortDescription: Sourced, screened, and ready candidates for contract or full-time roles.
list.description: Full-cycle staffing for employers — sourcing, screening, and delivering vetted candidates across contract, temp, and permanent roles.
list.notFor: Hiring one senior or specialized role instead? See Talent Acquisition.

list.title: Talent Acquisition
list.shortDescription: Strategic search for specialized and leadership hires.
list.description: A higher-touch search practice for roles where volume hiring won't work — specialized, senior, or hard-to-fill positions.
list.notFor: Filling a defined role quickly? Recruitment & Staffing is the faster route.

list.title: Background Verification
list.shortDescription: Thorough, compliant checks before an offer becomes a hire.
list.description: Employment history, education, and reference verification handled quickly and correctly, so an offer becomes a hire with confidence.
list.notFor: Available standalone, or bundled with any placement.

list.title: IT Training
list.shortDescription: Skill-building tracks that feed directly into our placement pipeline.
list.description: Structured programs in web development, QA, cloud, and data — built for graduates who want training that leads somewhere specific: a job.
list.notFor: Already have the skills? Go straight to Job Placement.
